items.title: Bob Shoffner Interview, 1959-09-08
items.q: So that's when Joe sent and got Ori, and had Ori to take him join the band.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, I didn't know. You see. Lost his feeling and all the parts.

Yeah, that's right. You see. So that's when Joe sent and got Ori, and had Ori to take him join the band. Yeah. Meanwhile they got Bud Scott in the band. Oh yeah. And they let Junie Kappa, Junie Kappa was playing banjo.
